EN: Well if it wasn't that Raider, then who was it? Look, you find that food, then maybe we'll consider letting the Raider go.
ZH: 可是如果不是那个掠夺者的话会是谁呢？听着，你们要是能找到食物，我们会考虑放了他。

EN: You. If you're here to beg for that Raider's life, you're wasting your time. Just turn around and go.
ZH: 听着，如果你们来是为了让我们放了那个掠夺者，那你们还是省省吧。转身出门不送。

EN: You! You're here to help, right? Look, I didn't do it. Whatever stole their grub, it's living somewhere in the building. And it sounds mean! Please, help me out here!
ZH: 你！你是来这里帮忙的是吗？听着，不是我干的，不管是谁偷了他们的食物，一定是这栋楼里的生物。而且肯定不好对付！求求你们，快救我出去！

EN: You uncovered a poorly written note among Nick's files, asking for his help in finding a kidnapped friend.
ZH: 你从尼克的档案里发现了一张字迹模糊的字条，上面请求他帮忙去寻找一位被绑架的朋友。

EN: Cause there ain't no one else around. Now, I ain't looking for an interrogation. I just want that mitt back. So go.
ZH: 因为附近也没有其他人。现在我不指望有什么审讯，我只想拿回我的手套。

EN: It's mine. That's what's special. And I won't have folks stealing from me. Now how about you hop to it, eh?
ZH: 那是我的，对我而言很特殊。我是不会让别人从我这里偷走它的。现在你们能开始调查了吗？

EN: Oh. You must be Nick's pal. Took ya long enough. You here to help me recover my great, great, great...
ZH: 哦，你们一定是尼克的朋友。等到你们可真不容易啊。你们来这里是为了帮我找回我曾曾曾曾……

EN: Hey, hey. Let's not do anything hasty here. I'll give you some of the other stuff I “recovered.” Now, don't you have a mitt to recover?
ZH: 嘿，先不要着急。我会给你们看看我“找回”的另外的东西。现在，你们能帮我找回手套了吗？

EN: A note among Nick's files requested his help in recovering a lost family heirloom - a pre-war catcher's mitt with great sentimental value.
ZH: 尼克的档案里有一张字条，请求他帮忙找回一件遗失的传家宝——一只颇具纪念意义的战前捕手手套。

EN: Oh thank goodness. Last time anyone spotted it, it was further into the Vault. Please. Take care of that beast before it kills again!
ZH: 哦，谢天谢地！上次有人见到它时，它还在避难所更深处。拜托了，趁那头野兽还没再害人，赶紧把它解决掉！

EN: Well, I didn't get a good look at it, but I can tell you it's hideous. Three heads, quick as a shot. But most of all, it loves Quantum. Stole every last bottle we had!
ZH: 呃，我没仔细看过，但我可以告诉你它很难看。有三个头，速度超快。最重要的是，它超爱量子核子可乐。它偷走了我们所有的存货！

EN: D-did Nick send you? You've got to help us! The “Quantum Creeper”. It's been eating our people. We're all that's left.
ZH: 是，是尼克派你来的吗？你得救救我们！“量子爬行者”。它一直在吃我们的人。我们就剩这些人了。

EN: Nick was asked to solve the mystery of “The Quantum Creeper,” a beast that's been munching on the citizens of a local Vault and stealing their Quantum. What say you lend them a hand?
ZH: 有人请求尼克去解开“量子爬行者”的谜题。这个怪兽把当地的避难所居民吃掉并偷走他们的量子核子可乐。去帮他们一下怎么样？

EN: A cat burglar has been hitting Vault after Vault, taking pets away from their owners. Stop them before they steal another cat!
ZH: 一个“飞贼”接连光顾一个个避难所，把宠物从主人身边偷走。趁他偷走下一只猫之前阻止他！

EN: We've received a call for help from Vault 505. They've been working on a special project that would allow Dwellers to play games on their Pip-Boys. Imagine that! Unfortunately, they've also been overrun with Radroaches. We have to help them!
ZH: 我们接到了来自505号避难所的求助电话。他们一直在做一个特殊的项目，可以让居民们在他们的哔哔小子上玩游戏。想象一下！不幸的是，他们还被辐射蟑螂侵扰。我们必须帮助他们！

EN: Across the Wasteland, rumors swirl of a treasure called the “Door Buster.” The race is on to claim this mysterious prize!
ZH: 废土上流传着一些关于“破门神器”的传说。抓紧时间看看谁能先抢到这件神秘的宝贝！

EN: We've heard strange rumors of a great treasure found at the end of the rainbow! Our calculations indicate that's near the abandoned talc mines to the West, ruled by a myserious Raider boss called “Shaun the Leper.”
ZH: 我们听到传闻，说有人在彩虹尽头发现了巨大宝藏！据我们计算，那就在西边废弃的滑石矿附近，由一个神秘的掠夺者头目“麻风尚恩”统治。

EN: Big Wes is calling you out! Time to dethrone him and become the Wasteland's number one big game hunter.
ZH: 大维斯在呼唤你！是时候让他下台，成为废土第一名的杀手了！

EN: A Raider Boss in the ruins of Vault 390 told me that Maxson's Roughnecks are in Vault-Tec Headquarters. I'm concerned for their safety, so I better armor up and hurry!
ZH: 390号避难所废墟里的掠夺者首领告诉我，“麦克森硬汉小队”在避难所科技的总部。我很担心他们的安危。所以赶紧穿好装备去找他们吧！

EN: Well, Coach wasn't in the sports bar. Maybe he's a teetotaler. He'd better not spill any darjeeling on that Jersey! Time to keep looking...
ZH: 好吧，教练并不在运动酒吧里。也许他是个禁酒主义者。他最好不要把什么茶水洒在那件棒球衫上。该继续寻找了……

EN: Like most bullies, Raiders are usually cowards. Rumor has it the Raider Boss who just took over the Mass Chemical building is exactly that, so maybe you can scare him off without a fight.
ZH: 和大多数恶霸一样，掠夺者通常都是胆小鬼。有传言说，刚刚占领大众化学大楼的那位掠夺者首领正是如此——也许你能不战而把他吓跑。

EN: Using information from our undercover agent, we've learned that Raiders are holding what could very well be secret weapon blueprints. We need a single Dweller to infiltrate their base and retrieve those documents ASAP.
ZH: 从我们的卧底特工得到信息，我们了解到掠夺者手中极有可能握着秘密武器蓝图。我们需要一个居民渗透进他们的基地，并尽快拿回这些文件。

EN: You! I've heard of you! You're not botanists! You're just Wasteland scum! I'm the only REAL scientist here!
ZH: 你们！我听说过你们！根本不是什么植物学家！是废土人渣！我才是这里唯一的科学家！

EN: A lunatic who calls himself Mole rat Man has been training Mole rats to attack settlements and steal their Tatos. Now's the time to strike!
ZH: 一个称自己为“鼹鼠人”的疯子训练鼹鼠们袭击定居点，抢走他们的红果。现在是时候反击了！

EN: Looks like you need a bigger challenge. How about hunting some humans for a change? This time you can only wear your Vault suits.
ZH: 看起来你需要更大的挑战，要不要试试猎杀一下人类？这次你只能穿你的避难所套装。

EN: No, but we've heard you're not the only ones who have been hit by this. Do you know any other farmers that have lost Tatos?
ZH: 我们不是，但我们听说你们不是唯一受影响的。你们知道有其他的农民也遇到类似情况的吗？

EN: All across the Commonwealth, Tatos are being wiped out by a mysterious blight. Settlers are starving! Maybe we can help.
ZH: 整个联邦的红果植株都在枯萎。定居者们要饿死了！也许我们能帮忙。

EN: While adventuring, a Dweller discovered a map to Vault 666. It's not on any official Vault-Tec registry. What secrets could it hold?
ZH: 一个居民探险的时候发现了一张去往666号避难所的地图，这个避难所并不在避难所科技的正式登记备案中。它有怎样的秘密呢？

EN: We've found out there's a group of settlers that has more information about the widespread Tato die-outs. Let's talk to them and see what they know.
ZH: 我们发现有一群定居者对大面积的红果植株死亡有更多的了解。和他们聊聊，看看他们都知道些什么。

EN: You've found the journal of Paula Plumbkin, an Overseer who went searching for the mythical utopia, Vaultopolis. Follow in her footsteps! First stop - Vault 730.
ZH: 你找到了宝拉·普朗布金的日志。这位监督者曾踏上旅途，寻找传说中的乌托邦“避难所之城”。沿着她的足迹前进吧！第一站——730号避难所。

EN: We need to find Vault 525, but our supplies are running low. It's time to visit the Super Duper Mart and scavenge whatever we can before continuing our search.
ZH: 我们需要找到525号避难所，但我们的物资告急。得去大无敌超市搜索一切能用的东西，然后继续上路。

EN: The official documentation Vault-Tec sent to the Mayor's office said that the entrance of Vault 525, a.k.a. Vaultopolis, is hidden in the Red Rocket Headquarters! What are you waiting for? Get to Vault 525!
ZH: 避难所科技送往市长办公室的正式文件里说，通往525号避难所，也就是避难所大都会的入口隐藏在红火箭总部里。你还在等什么，赶紧前往525避难所吧！

EN: We're close to tracking down the Wizard! Apparently his assistant abandoned him and is holed up at a Super-Duper Mart. We'll beat the truth out of him if we have to!
ZH: 我们快要找到水之术士了！显然，他的助手抛弃他，躲藏在一个大无敌超市里。万不得已的话，我们就打到他说出真相为止。

EN: We've had reports of nearby Settlers being randomly sprayed with radioactive material by unknown assailants. We should deliver some RadAway to those settlers and find out more about the attacks.
ZH: 我们收到关于附近的定居者被身份不明的袭击者随机喷洒放射性材料的报告。我们应该给这些定居者送些消辐宁，并查明这些袭击的更多信息。

EN: A friendly Ghoul in the nuclear power plant told us Paula Plumbkin continued her search for Vaultopolis in Vault 813. We're hot on her tail!
ZH: 核电站里一个友好的尸鬼告诉我们宝拉·普朗布金还在继续寻找大都会。她去了813号避难所，我们赶紧跟上吧。

EN: A keen-eyed Wasteland explorer has spotted a lonely cabin in the distance. Looks like someone, or something, is lurking inside.
ZH: 一位眼尖的探险者发现了一处孤零零的小屋。看上去像是，有人，或者有东西藏在里面。

EN: A keen-eyed Wasteland explorer has spotted a lonely outpost in the distance. Looks like someone, or something, is lurking inside.
ZH: 一位眼尖的废土探险家在远处发现了一个孤立的前哨。看来里面潜伏着什么人或什么生物。

EN: Folks are being stung all over, and the problem is coming from Earl's Radscorpion Emporium. Time to put him out of business.
ZH: 乡亲们经常被咬，这都是因为厄尔的辐射蝎生意。是时候叫停这些买卖了。

EN: Keep this to yourself, but we've been contacted by one of our deep agents, codename Moley, who says he's uncovered a massive conspiracy with vast ramifications. Go over to Vault 322 to hear Moley's big story!
ZH: 你要保密，我们的一个高级特工，代号莫里，联系过我们，他说他发现了一个巨大的阴谋，影响深远。到322号避难所去听莫里的大故事！

EN: Warrior botanists. You saved me from the Raiders that followed me here. I will be forever in your debt.
ZH: 植物学家斗士，谢谢你们把我从掠夺者手中救了出来。我永远都欠你们人情。

EN: He lives in that factory, training his “pretties.” Crazy man treats them like his children. Don't think he's right in the head.
ZH: 他住在那个工厂里，训练它的“小可爱”们。那个疯子把它们当自己的孩子。不要期待他脑子会正常。

EN: Some nefarious person has been training Mole rats to steal Tatos from under people's noses. We need to meet with a tracker who might have found the source.
ZH: 一个坏蛋一直在训练鼹鼠在人们眼皮底下窃取红果。去见见那个追踪者，他可能已经找到了事情发生的根源。

EN: We think Brother Will, the Church initiate who has gone missing, may have been kidnapped by a band of Raiders camped nearby. We'll send a team to rescue him, then inform Confessor Alvarado if and when we've brought him back to safety.
ZH: 我们认为失踪的教会见习信徒威尔修士可能被驻扎在附近的一帮掠夺者绑架了。我们会派一支队伍去救他，等他平安回来之后，再视情况通知忏悔者阿尔瓦拉多。

EN: So much for the spirit of giving! Some heartless Raiders have robbed a Wasteland Settler and stolen a gift meant for his friend.
ZH: 不要再讲什么奉献精神了！一些无情的掠夺者洗劫了一个废土定居者，偷走了他送给朋友的礼物。

EN: There's a group at a research lab off yonder that thinks it isn't a disease. They have an alternate theory...
ZH: 那边一个研究所里有群人认为这不是病害。他们另有一套说法……

EN: We've found out from a group of farmers that the Tato blight isn't restricted to just one location - it's hitting multiple farms throughout the Wasteland!
ZH: 我们从农夫嘴里了解到不止一个地方遭遇了红果枯萎——废土上的很多农场都没能幸免！

EN: They're a couple of tough cookies. I'm betting Sally would've taken cover in Vault 314. It's abandoned, so be careful!
ZH: 我打赌莎莉很可能会躲进314号避难所。那地方已废弃，千万小心！

EN: Overseer Emma said Bigsby stopped by their Vault. Since then, a salvage team took him on a run with them to the Atomatoys warehouse, but hasn't returned.
ZH: 监督者艾玛说比格斯比曾在他们的避难所停留，后来一个回收队带着它去了原子玩具仓库，就再没有回来。

EN: After he visits the settlers at the RobCo Plant, he comes here to get updates on supplies and treasure to bring back to the Editor.
ZH: 他拜访完罗伯科工厂的定居者之后，来到了这里搜刮物资和宝物并带回给编辑。

EN: I'd talk to the settlers at the RobCo Plant. They were the first to get hit. They'd know the more about the Bugle Boy and his Editor.
ZH: 我会和罗伯科工厂的定居者谈谈。他们是最先被袭击的。他们应该了解更多关于“号角男孩”和编辑的信息。

EN: That Deathclaw steak was a bit... stringy, to say the least. The chef feels bad about this, and wants to make his favorite comfort food, lasagna. Unfortunately, Raiders have stolen his secret sauce recipe, and we need to get it back from their towering lair first.
ZH: 至少可以这么说，这死爪牛排有点老。厨师有点失落，想做他最爱的慰藉美食——千层面。不幸的是，掠夺者偷了他的秘密酱汁的配方，我们需从他们的高耸的巢穴里找回它。

EN: Vault 813's Overseer Alvarez told us the same thing he told Paula Plumbkin - to search the Vault-Tec offices for info on Vaultopolis!
ZH: 813号避难所监督者阿尔瓦雷茨告诉我们和告诉宝拉同样的事 - 去避难所科技的办公室找到关于大都会的信息！

EN: The chef never ceases to be amazed by your uncanny ability to escape death, and he wants to celebrate it with a Radscorpion egg omelet. Vault 923 was recently overrun by these critters, so that'd be a good place to start.
ZH: 大厨对你死里逃生的能力表示惊讶。他想用辐射蝎蛋卷来庆祝。923号避难所最近被这些生物侵占了，不妨就从那里开始吧。

EN: There's an old Hardware Town store we haven't checked out. Maybe Coach went there to resupply. Off we go.
ZH: 有一家旧的“五金小镇”商店我们还没去看过。也许教练去那里补给物资了。我们出发吧。

EN: You've tracked the kidnapped settler to the lair of the Commish. Time to put an end to this football flunky's Super Cup contest!
ZH: 你已经知道被绑架的定居者在“总裁”那里。是时候终结这个足球怪人的“超级杯”比赛了！

EN: Love is in the air, and just like radioactive fallout  - once it gets inside you it doesn't get out! All we need now is a ring to pop the big question. We might have some luck finding Pre-War jewelry in a nearby abandoned building.
ZH: 空气中弥漫着爱意，就像放射性尘埃——一旦进入体内就再也出不来！我们现在需要的是一枚戒指来求婚。在附近的废弃建筑里说不定能找到一些战前珠宝。

EN: Some Raiders have taken over an old apartment complex. Maybe these jerks know the big jerk, Coach. Can't hurt to ask!
ZH: 一些掠夺者占领了一幢旧的复式公寓。也许这些混蛋们知道教练这个混蛋在哪儿。问问也无妨。

EN: All right, the Super-Duper Mart was a bust as far as ingredients go. This time, though, we have a sure lead to a cache of spice in a nearby building! And the chef is convinced the Raiders will just hand it over...
ZH: 好吧，你要找原料的话，大无敌超市不是个啥好去处。但是这回，我们肯定能在附近的一座建筑里找到一些香料！ 厨师相信那些掠夺者会把它们交出来……

EN: Someone made the mistake of activating a Wakemaster prototype alarm clock in a building not far from the Vault. Now the alarm is blaring non-stop and it's keeping everyone up!
ZH: 有人犯了个错误，激活了距离避难所不远的一幢建筑里的“叫早大师”原型闹钟。现在这个闹钟叫个不停，吵得每个人都睡不着。

EN: An old woman living near your Vault was expecting Holiday visitors, but they haven't arrived and she fears the worst!
ZH: 一位住在你们避难所附近的老妇人正期待着节日里的拜访者，但客人们还没有到，她担心他们出事了！
